facts.fact: A headline listed on the Association des Communes du Burundi page names 12 communes (Bubanza, Bukinanyana, Kayanza, Ngozi, Kirundo, Muyinga, Cankuzo, Ruyigi, Rutana, Gitega, Makamba, Nyanza) as pilots for E-TAXE digital taxation for communal revenue management; the headline carries no date, so the page's 2026-02-09 date is used.
